DESCRIPTION:
Validates that randomly selected books properly load their respective details page.

    Steps:
        1. Navigate to the sandbox homepage.
        2. Identify all rendered product cards.
        3. Randomly select 5 unique book index entries.
        4. For each selection: capture the display title, navigate to its product 
           profile, assert the matching top-level H1 header, ensure the spec grid 
           is visible, and navigate back home.
NAME: test_02[chromium]

DESCRIPTION:
Verifies baseline layout and element constraints for the Books to Scrape homepage.

    This test executes an end-to-end integration check against the target sandbox web
    application to ensure server response validity, structural typography components, 
    and mandatory interface segments are fully loaded and formatted.

    Validation steps include:
        1. Confirms the website handles connections correctly (HTTP 200 OK).
        2. Asserts destination URL mapping doesn't trigger unexpected redirects.
        3. Validates the window title strictly matches the expected application state.
        4. Scans and confirms all visible structural typography headers (H1-H6) 
           contain valid text payloads.
        5. Validates that book section grid is active on page load.

    Args:
        page (Page): The standard Playwright sync page fixture context injected by pytest.

    Raises:
        AssertionError: If network responses fail, text configurations are missing,
            or required tag hierarchies violate baseline structural expectations.
NAME: test_01[chromium]

DESCRIPTION:
Verifies product image integrity across the first pages of the Books to Scrape catalog.

    This test walks through the paginated product listing and inspects every book
    cover image to ensure each one is rendered and carries the attributes the
    site's markup is expected to provide.

    Validation steps include:
        1. Confirms each visited page contains at least one product image.
        2. Asserts every image is visible on screen.
        3. Asserts every image has a non-empty src attribute.
        4. Asserts every image has a non-empty alt attribute.
        5. Asserts every image class list includes the "thumbnail" class.
        6. Follows the "next" link to the following page, stopping after five pages
           or when no further page is available.

    Args:
        page (Page): The standard Playwright sync page fixture context injected by pytest.

    Raises:
        AssertionError: If a page has no product images, or if an image is missing
            its src, alt, or expected "thumbnail" class.
NAME: test_05[chromium]

DESCRIPTION:
Verifies that book titles and prices stay consistent between the homepage and detail pages.

    This test samples random products from the Books to Scrape homepage, opens each
    product's detail page, and cross-checks the listing data against the detail data
    to ensure the catalog presents the same information in both places.

    Validation steps include:
        1. Confirms the product grid is loaded and the first book card is visible.
        2. Asserts at least five book cards are available for sampling.
        3. Randomly selects five distinct book cards from the homepage.
        4. Opens each selected book and confirms the detail page heading contains
           the homepage title (trailing dots from truncated titles are ignored).
        5. Confirms the detail page price matches the homepage price exactly.
        6. Navigates back and confirms the product grid is restored.

    Args:
        page (Page): The standard Playwright sync page fixture context injected by pytest.

    Raises:
        AssertionError: If fewer than five books are listed, or if a title or price
            differs between the homepage and the detail page.
NAME: test_03[chromium]

DESCRIPTION:
Verifies that every link on the Books to Scrape homepage is valid and reachable.

    This test collects all anchor elements from the homepage and requests each
    destination over HTTP to catch missing or broken links before users find them.

    Validation steps include:
        1. Collects every anchor element present on the homepage.
        2. Asserts each anchor has a non-empty href attribute.
        3. Resolves relative hrefs into absolute URLs using the current page URL.
        4. Sends a GET request for each URL through a shared requests session.
        5. Confirms every destination responds with HTTP 200 OK.

    Args:
        page (Page): The standard Playwright sync page fixture context injected by pytest.

    Raises:
        AssertionError: If an anchor has no href, or if any linked URL returns a
            status code other than 200.
NAME: test_04[chromium]

DESCRIPTION:
Verifies the login flow on the Quotes to Scrape sandbox site.

    This test performs an end-to-end login using the demo credentials and checks
    that the interface reflects an authenticated session afterwards.

    Validation steps include:
        1. Confirms the Login link is visible on the homepage and clicks it.
        2. Asserts the browser lands on the login page URL.
        3. Types the username and password character by character with a delay
           to simulate real keyboard input.
        4. Submits the form and asserts the user is redirected to the homepage.
        5. Confirms the Logout link is visible and points to "/logout",
           indicating a successful login.

    Args:
        page (Page): The standard Playwright sync page fixture context injected by pytest.

    Raises:
        AssertionError: If the Login link is missing, a URL redirect is incorrect,
            or the Logout link is not shown with the expected href after login.
